mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, we are looking at 48 degrees with overcast skies near Harriet Park and a Third Quarter moon overhead.

October is now Community Planning Month in Verona, recognizing the hard work of our planning department. Also, please keep an eye out for potential mail regarding cross connection surveys from the city water utility.
We have plenty of fun ahead with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, the Dane County Farmers Market tomorrow, and the World Dairy Expo this Saturday.
Reflecting on the past couple of weeks, on September 21, police identified and cited an individual for the retail theft of candy from a business on East Verona Avenue.
Our local Culver's will be serving up the Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough flavor of the day when they open today at 10:00 AM.
